name: Inland Center
summary: Inland Center is a bustling regional mall in San Bernardino offering familiar retail stores, casual dining options, and family-friendly amenities including a kids' play area. With convenient hours and a diverse tenant mix, it serves as a comprehensive shopping destination for the Inland Empire community.
demographics: Inland Center primarily serves middle-income families and value-conscious shoppers from San Bernardino and the surrounding Inland Empire communities. The trade area attracts a diverse, multi-generational customer base with household incomes ranging from lower-middle to middle class, including young families drawn to the kids' play area and budget-friendly retail options. Typical visitors are seeking affordable fashion, dining, and entertainment options in a traditional enclosed mall setting, with shopping patterns reflecting a preference for national chain retailers and casual dining experiences.
description: Inland Center stands as a prominent retail destination in San Bernardino, California, serving the Inland Empire community with a comprehensive shopping experience. This bustling enclosed regional mall features a diverse mix of familiar national retailers, casual dining restaurants, and a convenient food court that caters to shoppers throughout the day. Families particularly appreciate the dedicated kids' play area, making it a popular destination for multi-generational shopping trips. The center operates daily from 10 AM to 8 PM, providing ample opportunity for visitors to explore its wide array of stores and amenities. With a strong 4.3-star rating from over 8,000 reviews, Inland Center has established itself as a reliable shopping hub where the San Bernardino community can find everything from fashion and accessories to dining and entertainment under one roof.
